name: Qwen Audio 3.1 Realtime Flash
description: Realtime conversational model with text and audio responses, tool calling, web search and voice cloning.
notes: Alibaba’s own model availability table dates the Flash release October 27 and specifies 262144 tokens. Native speech docs additionally limit retained audio to 50 turns or 300 seconds. Unlike a standalone TTS or transcription model, it generates conversational text, including a text-only response mode. Parameter counts and architecture are undisclosed; the current Qwen model inventory has no exact public checkpoint.

name: Unlimited OCR 2
description: Vision-language model for document parsing with sparse reference sliding-window attention.
notes: Baidu’s dated release notes establish October 27, independently of repository creation. The nominal 3B figure is scoped to the language decoder in technical-report Figure 3 and is not the complete multimodal model size. The report prose gives 500M activated parameters, while Figure 3 labels the decoder A570M; the active count remains unset because the discrepancy is unexplained. Released config sets 131072 positions; unlimited-horizon parsing uses bounded sliding/reference windows, not an infinite token context.

No downloadable exact checkpoint was found in the launch links or public Hugging Face search. API documentation could not be retrieved, so context remains unspecified.

name: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B
description: Language model trained to write and update long-term agent memory.
notes: October release is explicitly documented in the developer repository. This is a released text-generation checkpoint, separate from the memory framework and its desktop application.
